samples.stimulus: In the pie chart shown, each section represents one category of the after-school activity chosen by the students at a middle school. A total of 20 students are represented. The size of each section is labeled as a percent of the whole. Two students are chosen at random, one after the other, without replacement. Answer the question using only the data in the pie chart.
samples.question: What is the probability that both students are in the category "Chess"?
samples.explanation: (1) 원그래프에서 각 부채꼴의 값을 읽는다: Robotics 30%, Chess 25%, Debate 20%, Choir 15%, Art club 10%. (2) Chess 는 20 × 0.25 = 5 이다. (3) 첫 번째가 Chess 일 확률 = 5/20 이다. (4) 두 번째는 4/19 이다. (5) 곱 = 5/20 × 4/19 이다. (6) 따라서 답은 1/19 이다. 따라서 정답은 1/19이다.
